runtime_and_platform.isolation: No stage-1 command ran. For a host run, the recipe's host-wide rules apply: commands act on <Name> only, and the rehearsal's R1 terminates and unregisters only its own throwaway name; no .wslconfig change (W1 only reads two keys with Select-String), no wsl --update and never wsl --shutdown; the only stop is wsl --terminate <Name>; the default distribution stays the workstation's; and W6 exports the failed attempt before any --unregister.
